events.title: CVE-2026-124615
events.summary:
The shell command ACL for the feature scope (etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg) restricts feature:install, feature:uninstall, feature:start and feature:stop to the admin role, but had no entry for feature:requirement-add or feature:requirement-remove.

The provisioning resolver turns a requirement into the same install/start (or uninstall) action as feature:install / feature:uninstall: a bundle: requirement causes an arbitrary bundle to be downloaded and started, and a feature: requirement installs that feature. Because the two commands had no ACL, a user authenticated with only the viewer (and ssh) role could invoke them and cause Apache Karaf to download, install and start an attacker-chosen bundle, which then runs with the full authority of the Karaf process — thereby bypassing the admin-only authorization enforced on feature:install and bundle:install.

This is the same class of issue as the feature:repo-add -i / feature:repo-remove -u bypass, on sibling commands not covered by that earlier fix.Mitigation:Upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.12 or 4.5.0 (or later), which restrict feature:requirement-add and feature:requirement-remove to the admin role.

As an interim workaround on affected versions, add the following two lines to etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg; the change is picked up at runtime without a restart:

requirement-add = admin

requirement-remove = admin

events.title: CVE-2026-129833
events.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can trigger a stack-based buffer overflow by sending a malformed log message containing an embedded IPv4-in-IPv6 address to an instance configured with the mmanon anonymization module. This flaw causes the logging service to crash, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

events.title: CVE-2026-130808
events.summary:
In Apache Karaf, the default command ACL configuration for the feature scope (etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg, defined in assemblies/features/standard/src/main/feature/feature.xml and the child-instance template instance/src/main/resources/org/apache/karaf/instance/resources/etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg) restricts feature:install, feature:uninstall, feature:start, and feature:stop to users with the admin role, while leaving feature:requirement-add and feature:requirement-remove without ACL entries.


Because Karaf's command guard (SecuredSessionFactoryImpl) allows commands with no matching ACL rule (NO_MATCH) to execute, an authenticated SSH user holding only the ssh and viewer roles can execute feature:requirement-add bundle:<uri> (or feature:<name>). RequirementAdd forwards the requirement directly to FeatureService.addRequirements(), causing the resolver to download, install, and start an arbitrary bundle with the Karaf JVM process's full authority, bypassing the admin-only restrictions on feature:install and bundle:install. Similarly, feature:requirement-remove allows removing provisioning requirements and uninstalling features/bundles.

MitigationUsers are recommended to upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.13 or 4.5.0.




For existing deployments or upgrades that preserve existing files in etc/, add the following rules to etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg (and any child instance etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg files):




requirement-add = admin 

requirement-remove = admin

events.title: CVE-2026-134019
events.summary: PyTables is a Python package to manage extremely large amounts of data. In 3.11.1 and earlier, tables/attributeset.py treats a NumPy bytes scalar ending in a period as a pickled Python object and calls pickle.loads() when the attribute is accessed through AttributeSet.__getattr__ or AttributeSet.__getitem__. Opening an attacker-controlled HDF5 file and reading an affected metadata attribute can execute attacker-controlled code in the consumer’s process. No fixed version is available as of this review.

events.title: CVE-2026-134034
events.summary: HortusFox is a self-hosted web application for collaborative plant management. Prior to 6.2, the toggle_boolean_value() handler in app/controller/admin.php passes the name parameter of the /admin/environment/boolean/toggle route in app/config/routes.php to AppModel::updateSingle() in app/models/AppModel.php, which concatenates the parameter into the SQL UPDATE identifier position without validation. An unauthenticated attacker can induce a signed-in administrator to open a crafted link, causing SQL injection that permits expressions and subqueries to read database contents, including an administrator password hash, or modify settings to enable passwordless administrator access. The hash alone does not permit direct login. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.

events.title: CVE-2026-134959
events.summary: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Webdeclic WPMasterToolKit wpmastertoolkit allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects WPMasterToolKit: from n/a through 2.26.1.

events.title: CVE-2026-135387
events.summary: HortusFox is a self-hosted web application for collaborative plant management. Prior to 6.2, state-changing AdminController routes in app/config/routes.php accept GET requests. The affected AdminController in app/controller/admin.php does not invoke Asatru\Controller\PostValidator to check CSRF tokens. An unauthenticated attacker can induce a signed-in administrator to open a cross-site link, causing privileged actions such as changing environment settings, deleting users or locations, managing API keys, or clearing cached data. In the tested build, a cross-site POST to /admin/user/update can promote a user immediately after login; in default Chromium the POST succeeds within the approximately two-minute Lax+POST grace period but not with an aged cookie, and other browser configurations may permit the POST. Version 6.2 mitigates the documented GET path, but no complete anti-CSRF fix is documented.

events.title: CVE-2026-135388
events.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.0.0 until 3.1.13, the implementation selected signature verification based on the certificate public key while deriving the digest from the peer-controlled signature scheme without validating that the scheme, key type, and hash requirements were consistent. The affected verification functions are verifyKeySignature for ServerKeyExchange and verifyCertificateVerify for CertificateVerify. An unauthenticated network attacker who can redirect a DTLS handshake and obtain the genuine peer certificate can submit crafted handshake signatures that are accepted without possession of the certificate private key. This can let the attacker impersonate the peer and compromise the confidentiality and integrity of protected traffic; checking a WebRTC SDP certificate fingerprint does not prevent the attack because the genuine certificate is presented. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.

events.title: CVE-2026-135389
events.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.0 until 3.1.14, a server with a SessionStore saved the session ID and master secret after ClientKeyExchange, before receiving a valid Finished message and before enforcing the configured client-authentication checks. A remote client can omit its Certificate message, send ClientKeyExchange, leave the first handshake unfinished, and then resume the cached session using the master secret it learned during key exchange. The server must use a SessionStore and negotiate a certificate-based cipher suite. The attack can bypass client certificates required through RequireAnyClientCert or RequireAndVerifyClientCert, or a rejecting VerifyConnection callback. WebRTC users are not affected. The abbreviated handshake can allow unauthorized access to application data. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.14.

events.title: CVE-2026-135390
events.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.0 until 3.1.14, a listener performing DTLS 1.2 resumption accepted a session created by an outbound client connection without checking which role created it. A malicious server previously contacted by the application can retain the outbound session secret, select the client-side cached session through its session key, and present it to the application's reachable listener when both connections share a SessionStore. The attacker must first complete an outbound connection. WebRTC users are not affected. The listener can accept application data without running its normal PSK callback or client-certificate authentication checks, allowing a peer trusted only for an outbound connection to gain unauthorized listener access. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.14.

events.title: CVE-2026-135391
events.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.0.0 until 3.1.13, peer certificates were parsed and their RSA public keys were passed to handshake signature and certificate-chain verification without an explicit modulus-size limit. A remote peer can provide a certificate with an unusually large attacker-chosen RSA modulus and an invalid signature; no corresponding private key or valid handshake signature is required to trigger the expensive operation. An RSA verification path must execute. A local ECDSA certificate does not prevent the peer from presenting an RSA certificate, and WebRTC deployments can be affected. Repeated or concurrent malicious handshakes can consume substantial CPU resources, delay legitimate connections, and reduce service availability. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.

events.title: CVE-2026-135392
events.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.4 until 3.1.13, the handshake cache copied and retained submitted messages without deduplicating entries, limiting the entry count, limiting total payload bytes, or stopping new insertions after handshake completion. A remote peer able to deliver suitable DTLS traffic can grow the cache through incoming handshake messages and repeated caching of outgoing retransmissions for the lifetime of the connection. The fragment reassembly buffer's separate size limit does not prevent this issue because completed messages are retained in the append-only handshake cache. Unbounded cache growth can exhaust application memory and cause a denial of service. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.

events.title: CVE-2026-135393
events.summary: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 1.2.2 until 3.1.13, the server state machine did not distinguish successful processing of the client certificate flight from completion of the handshake, so later traffic could revisit the same cached Certificate, ClientKeyExchange, and CertificateVerify messages. A malicious client can withhold Finished and send additional handshake traffic. Depending on the configured authentication policy, repeated work can include certificate parsing, handshake signature verification, and certificate-chain verification. The vulnerable endpoint must act as the DTLS server. Pion WebRTC applications are affected when they operate in that role. Repeated or concurrent attempts can consume excessive CPU resources, delay legitimate connections, and reduce service availability. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.

events.title: CVE-2026-135480
events.summary: Insert Pages plugin for WordPress (insert-pages) before 3.11.6 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the insert_pages_handle_shortcode_insert() function that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to read draft, pending, scheduled, and private posts they do not own. Attackers can reference sequential post IDs in the [insert page] shortcode to render the full content, title, excerpt, and metadata of unpublished posts, since the function checks a generic read capability instead of enforcing the read_post meta capability tied to post author and status.

events.title: CVE-2026-135481
events.summary: Listdom by Webilia plugin for WordPress before 6.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to retrieve the email address and user ID of every registered user. Attackers can exploit the LSD_Ajax::autosuggest() handler by setting the source parameter to users and repeating requests with different term values to enumerate the full user base, including administrators, bypassing the 10-result limit.

events.title: CVE-2026-135788
events.summary: A weakness has been identified in D-Link DIR-X1860 4.5.2. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /usr/sbin/anweb. Executing a manipulation can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

events.title: CVE-2026-135789
events.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in D-Link R95 101B06. Affected by this issue is the function GetBluetoothAdapterSettings/GetBluetoothBloodPressure/GetBluetoothDeviceList/GetBluetoothScanDeviceList/SetBluetoothAdapterSettings/SetBluetoothUnpairDevice/SetTriggerBluetoothScan/SetBluetoothPairDevice of the file /bin/ssi of the component DHMAPI SOAP Handler. The manipulation of the argument inner_xml leads to os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-135790
events.summary: A vulnerability was detected in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. This affects an unknown part of the file /cgi-bin/dashboard/ajax_chart_dump. The manipulation of the argument isntmeye results in os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-136177
events.summary: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the server send HTTP requests by supplying a url to /api/gitea/test-connection or /api/github/test-connection. Attackers can target internal network services and cloud instance metadata endpoints, reading response content leaked through upstream error messages returned by httpGet.

events.title: CVE-2026-136178
events.summary: Endurain before 0.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/strava/link endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify Strava integrations using only a victim's strava_state value. Attackers can submit a leaked state with their own OAuth code to link an attacker-controlled Strava account, or an invalid code to remove the victim's integration.

events.title: CVE-2026-136179
events.summary: EpicStaff 1.2.0 before 1.3.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in DocumentViewSet download and copy endpoints that allows authenticated users to access other organizations' documents. Attackers holding Knowledge Sources permissions in one organization can enumerate sequential document IDs to download or copy foreign documents, or insert documents into another organization's collection.

events.title: CVE-2026-136180
events.summary: Movary before 0.78.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to make the server request internal hosts by submitting crafted Jellyfin or Plex server URLs. Attackers can target internal services directly since URL validation is disabled by default, or bypass it via DNS rebinding, redirects, or AAAA records to probe internal network state.

events.title: CVE-2026-136181
events.summary: cnpmcore 3.46.0 before 3.84.3 and 4.0.0 before 4.37.3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain upstream registry authTokens via the GET /-/registry endpoints lacking AdminAccess middleware. Attackers can request /-/registry or /-/registry/:id and replay the leaked authToken as a Bearer credential to enumerate, download, or publish packages upstream.

events.title: CVE-2026-136182
events.summary: HarnessRouter 0.4.2 before 0.32.2 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the self-hosted sign-in UI that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users via the unvalidated next query parameter. Attackers can send crafted login links with an external, protocol-relative, or backslash-prefixed next value so victims are sent to attacker sites after signing in, enabling phishing.

events.title: CVE-2026-136183
events.summary: Mercur @mercurjs/core before 2.3.2 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated vendors to access other sellers by substituting the :id path parameter. Attackers can read payment and tax details, overwrite profiles and addresses, and invite, remove, or re-role team members to take over another vendor's store.

events.title: CVE-2026-136184
events.summary: compose-farm 0.19.0 before 1.22.0 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking and cross-site request forgery vulnerability because its unauthenticated web UI performs no Origin validation. Malicious websites visited by users can open /ws/shell/{host} or /ws/exec sockets, or abuse unquoted service parameters and PUT /api/console/file, to execute commands on all managed hosts.

events.title: CVE-2026-136185
events.summary: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.

events.title: CVE-2026-136186
events.summary: plugNmeet-server before 2.5.3 contains an authorization flaw in PollsController.HandleUserSubmitResponse that allows authenticated room participants to submit poll votes as other users by supplying an arbitrary UserId. Attackers can set UserId to another participant's id to cast votes on their behalf or block their legitimate votes, manipulating poll results.

events.title: CVE-2026-136187
events.summary: Spug 4.0.0 before 4.1.1 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to execute commands by supplying a crafted git URL to the /api/credential/check/ endpoint. Attackers can inject shell metacharacters into the data field passed to git ls-remote with shell=True, executing commands as the Spug service account, which is root in Docker deployments.

events.title: CVE-2026-136188
events.summary: Spug before 4.1.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator users to read per-host SSH private keys through the GET /api/host/ endpoint. Users granted a host can read the cleartext pkey field returned by Host.to_view and log in directly over SSH, bypassing Spug's permissions and audit trail even after revocation.

events.title: CVE-2026-136189
events.summary: Schmitech ORBIT before 2.17.15 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the permission_or_api_key dependency that allows any valid API key to access /admin management routes. Attackers holding a chat inference API key can read other keys in plaintext, rewrite config.yaml, and manage adapters and prompts to take over server administration.

events.title: CVE-2026-136190
events.summary: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /api/sso/providers handlers that allows any authenticated user to access other users' SSO providers without ownership checks. Attackers can read every OIDC client secret in clear text and overwrite or delete providers, redirecting authorization and token endpoints to attacker-controlled servers.

events.title: CVE-2026-136191
events.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in gf_rtsp_do_deinterleave that allows malicious RTSP servers to hang clients by sending non-RTSP, non-interleaved data. Attackers can answer a client request with a few bytes not starting with '$', 'RTSP', or 'HTTP', causing the RTSP client thread to spin forever and consume a full CPU core.

events.title: CVE-2026-136192
events.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SDP_ParseAttribute that allows attackers to cause unbounded memory growth via a NUL byte in an a=fmtp line. Attackers can supply a crafted .sdp file or malicious RTSP DESCRIBE response to hang gf_sdp_info_parse and exhaust memory, causing denial of service.

events.title: CVE-2026-136193
events.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the STAP-A handling of gf_rtp_parse_h264 in rtp_depacketizer.c due to unchecked aggregation unit sizes. A malicious RTP sender or RTSP server can send STAP-A packets with oversized NAL unit lengths to disclose adjacent heap memory or crash the client.

events.title: CVE-2026-136194
events.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_amr that allows remote RTP senders or malicious RTSP servers to read beyond packet buffers by sending crafted AMR/AMR-WB payloads. Attackers can send short packets whose TOC entries all set the F bit, causing out-of-bounds frame data to be copied into decoder output, disclosing memory or crashing the client.

events.title: CVE-2026-136195
events.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to crash clients by sending MP4V-ES RTP payloads shorter than 4 bytes. A remote RTP sender or malicious RTSP server can send a short packet after a marker-bit packet, causing an unsigned wraparound in the VOP start-code search loop that reads past the buffer and causes denial of service.

events.title: CVE-2026-136196
events.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to trigger excessive looping by advertising an undersized AU-headers-length. Attackers can send a crafted 22-byte AAC-hbr RTP packet from an RTP sender or malicious RTSP server to run about 2^28 iterations, pinning a CPU core and stalling clients.

events.title: CVE-2026-136197
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the glTF 1.0 importer that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory by supplying an unchecked KHR_binary_glTF image bufferView. Attackers can craft a glTF or GLB file whose bufferView byteOffset or byteLength exceeds its buffer, disclosing heap memory through embedded texture data or crashing the process.

events.title: CVE-2026-136198
events.summary: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an invalid mesh reference vulnerability in glTF2Exporter::ExportMeshes that causes out-of-bounds access when meshes without faces are skipped during export. Attackers can supply a PLY point cloud or degenerate glTF 2.0 TRIANGLE_STRIP model exported to gltf2 or glb2 to crash the application or trigger out-of-bounds memory reads and writes.

events.title: CVE-2026-136199
events.summary: libical before 4.0.7 contains a denial of service vulnerability because icalparser_clean() does not reset the parser nesting level when reusing an icalparser. Attackers can submit a single malformed calendar with unclosed or mismatched BEGIN/END lines, causing later calendars to be silently dropped and memory to grow unbounded.

events.title: CVE-2026-136241
events.summary: UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

events.title: CVE-2026-136271
events.summary: Allot's Subscriber Management Platform (SMP) v18.3.53 stores sensitive configuration credentials protected by a product‑wide, hard‑coded master password. The master key is constructed using a hard-coded string value plus a default key value. This results in an effective encryption key that is recoverable from shipped scripts and configuration files. The platform uses a deprecated and cryptographically insecure algorithm (PBEWithMD5AndDES) and no documented mechanism exists to change the key. An attacker with read access to configuration files, backups, or diagnostic bundles can recover credentials and TLS keystore/truststore passwords, and access to subscriber-management operations and subscriber PII.

events.title: CVE-2026-50048
events.summary: Genetec Security Center can expose access control unit credentials in plain text in server log files when specific non-default logging options are enabled. An attacker with local access to the affected log files could retrieve and use these credentials.

events.title: CVE-2026-82168
events.summary: Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability in ssl_config.properties. An unauthenticated local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to credential exposure.

events.title: CVE-2026-82169
events.summary: Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains an OS Command Injection – confirm single CWE vulnerability in Upgrade Service. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution.

events.title: CVE-2026-82170
events.summary: Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains a Server-Side Request Forgery SSRF vulnerability in httpRest.js. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to internal services

events.title: CVE-2026-82313
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a business logic 
vulnerability that may allow access to a higher privileged
account, which can then be used to execute commands 
or code. An account with high privileges and a 
configured SMTP server are required. The risk is lower in 
Windows installations.

events.title: CVE-2026-82314
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by denial-of-service 
vulnerability that may allow users with privileged access 
to cause too much memory usage, causing the server to 
reject new connections. A specific configuration is 
required, and an SMTP server must be set up.

events.title: CVE-2026-82315
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by another Time-of-Check 
to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) vulnerability. A user with 
domain administrator or higher privileges may be able to
access or modify protected files outside the intended 
directory, potentially leading to code execution. The risk 
is lower in Windows installations.

events.title: CVE-2026-82316
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a Time-of-Check to 
Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) vulnerability. A user with domain 
administrator or higher privileges may be able to access 
or modify protected files outside the intended directory, 
potentially leading to code execution. The risk is lower in
Windows installations.

events.title: CVE-2026-82317
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a stored cross-site 
scripting vulnerability. This is a Linux-only issue that was
caused by a lack of input validation and only affects 
administrators.

events.title: CVE-2026-82319
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerability. A user with domain 
administrator or higher privileges may allow a user to 
modify protected files outside their home directory. The 
issue can result in read and write access to the 
application files and privilege escalation. The risk is 
lower in Windows installations.

events.title: CVE-2026-82320
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by another 
type confusion vulnerability that may allow domain 
administrators to escalate privileges to that of a system 
administrator. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

events.title: CVE-2026-82321
events.summary:
SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by a type 
confusion vulnerability that may allow domain 
administrators to escalate privileges to that of a system 
administrator. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

events.title: CVE-2026-82322
events.summary: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a domain group administrator to bypass restrictions and escalate privileges to the server administrator level. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

events.title: CVE-2026-109484
events.summary: Failure to sanitize special elements into a different plane (special element injection) in Azure App Service allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

events.title: CVE-2026-111511
events.summary: Dell PowerStore contains a weak password-storage vulnerability that could allow an attacker with access to the credential store to recover user passwords by offline brute force.

events.title: CVE-2026-111546
events.summary: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to root on the appliance.

events.title: CVE-2026-116445
events.summary: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a local privilege-escalation vulnerability that could allow a low-privileged attacker to execute code in the kernel on the NAS node.

events.title: CVE-2026-121754
events.summary:
Parallels Desktop inittool2 Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Parallels Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target host system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the inittool2 component. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the component to take ownership of critical folders. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root on the host system. Was ZDI-CAN-30268.

events.title: CVE-2026-121755
events.summary:
Parallels Desktop Handle-based Rename Time-Of-Check Time-Of-Use Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Parallels Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target guest system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the implementation of handle-based rename functionality. The issue results from the lack of proper locking when performing operations on an object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the current user on the host system. Was ZDI-CAN-30608.

events.title: CVE-2026-121756
events.summary:
Parallels Desktop CSHAShellExt Improper Access Control Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Parallels Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target guest system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the CSHAShellExt component. The issue results from improper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the hypervisor. Was ZDI-CAN-30030.

events.title: CVE-2026-129425
events.summary: Joomla Extension - regularlabs.com - PHP code injection via content inserted during article preparation in Sourcerer extension < 18.0.0 - Sourcerer decided whether PHP may run based on the author or last editor of the host article and applied that decision to complete code blocks that other extensions, such as Users Anywhere, inserted into the article while it was prepared. A user able to edit a value rendered by such an extension, for example the display name in their own user profile, could therefore have PHP executed in the context of a trusted article. Sourcerer 18.0.0 authorizes each executable block against its own source; Users Anywhere 3.1.0, ReReplacer 16.4.0 and Snippets 11.2.0 supply the source information needed to keep executing eligible saved content.

events.title: CVE-2026-129984
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.67 to 0.11.2, organization and team billing-manager roles intended only for spend management are treated as ordinary members across workflow, run, library, and marketplace routes. Although the role matrix in autogpt_platform/autogpt_libs/autogpt_libs/auth/permissions.py withholds run access and workflow creation, those routes do not enforce the matrix and their underlying membership lookups ignore the caller's role. As a result, a team billing manager can read team workflows and other members' runs (including inputs, outputs, and per-node data), while an organization billing manager can view shared workflows and runs and create workflows and marketplace listings; neither can modify or delete other members' workflows. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.3.

Malicious JavaScript may be executed in a victim's browser when they browse to the page containing the vulnerable field. Scope is changed.

events.title: CVE-2026-124324
events.summary:
A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki allows SERVICE operations to bypass restrictions on administration operations.



This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki: from through 6.2.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-129317
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.41 through 0.11.1, the OAuth provider endpoints check a calling application's client secret against a scrypt hash synchronously on the REST API event loop. Anyone who knows the client ID of an active confidential OAuth application can stall the REST API for all users by sending a stream of requests with a wrong secret. No account or token is required. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.2.

events.title: CVE-2026-129959
events.summary:
When sftpEnabled=true (the default configuration in etc/org.apache.karaf.shell.cfg), the SSH server exposes the karaf.base directory tree through the MINA SSHD SFTP subsystem and SCP command factory without verifying the authenticated user's roles beyond the initial sshRole login check. Consequently, an authenticated user with only low-privileged roles (such as viewer and ssh) can read sensitive configuration and key files (including etc/users.properties and etc/host.key) or write arbitrary bundles/configurations into monitored directories (such as deploy/ or etc/), leading to privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution.


Apache Karaf 4.4.13 and 4.5.0 introduce the sftpRole configuration property in org.apache.karaf.shell (defaulting to admin) and enforce role-based access control on SFTP subsystem creation, SCP command execution, and virtual filesystem access.

Mitigation / WorkaroundUsers are recommended to upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.13 or 4.5.0.




On earlier versions where SFTP/SCP access is not required, set sftpEnabled=false in etc/org.apache.karaf.shell.cfg and restart the SSH server bundle (or Karaf instance).

events.title: CVE-2026-130171
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.5 through 0.10.0, marketplace and shared agents can capture a user's saved SMTP or database login. SendEmailBlock and SQLQueryBlock logged in with the running user's saved SMTP or database credential to whatever server the graph's author put in the node's inputs, with no check that the login belonged to that server. Anyone who publishes a marketplace listing or shares an agent file can capture the saved login of each user who adds it to their library and runs it once, in plaintext. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-133865
events.summary: Path traversal in the Microsoft VPN entry in Devolutions Remote Desktop Manager 2026.3.18.0 and earlier allows an attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended directory via a crafted .rdm file imported by a user.

events.title: CVE-2026-134066
events.summary:
Improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic in the query construction of AWS Graph Explorer before 3.2.1 might allow an authenticated remote user with write access to the connected graph database to access and modify data in that database with Graph Explorer's privileges via a crafted property key or label that is used when another user performs a search.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to Graph Explorer version 3.2.1 or later.

events.title: CVE-2026-134068
events.summary:
A stack-based buffer overflow in the replication origin name parsing component in AWS pgactive before 2.1.10 might allow an authenticated remote user to execute arbitrary operating system commands as the database operating system user via a crafted replication origin name.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to pgactive version 2.1.10 or later.

events.title: CVE-2026-134986

events.title: CVE-2026-135614
events.summary:
Improper removal of sensitive information in the troubleshooting tool in the Amazon ECS MCP Server (awslabs.ecs-mcp-server) before 0.1.36 might allow a remote actor who can influence the agent's input to obtain cleartext container environment variable values and secret references from ECS task definitions, which the server's sensitive data setting is intended to redact, via prompt injection that causes the agent to request troubleshooting guidance.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 0.1.36 or later and rotate any credentials stored as plaintext task definition environment variables.

events.title: CVE-2026-135794
events.summary: A vulnerability was determined in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. The affected element is the function add_crontab of the file admin/cgi-bin/sac/ajax_sac_crontab of the component SAC. Executing a manipulation of the argument cmd can lead to code injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-135796
events.summary: A vulnerability was determined in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. This issue affects the function exec/system of the file modules/assets/port_serve_scan.mds of the component Web Management UI. This manipulation of the argument task_name/where/path causes os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-135797
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. Impacted is the function exec of the file sslvpn/sslvpn_client.php of the component SSLVPN Client. Such manipulation of the argument img leads to os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-135798
events.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. The affected element is an unknown function of the file include/sqlite3.inc of the component Web Management Interface. Performing a manipulation results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-136404
events.summary: ntop n2n supernode 3.0 through 3.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to leak memory and execute code by sending an untrusted 16-bit auth token_size in REGISTER_SUPER_NAK datagrams. Attackers can register an edge in a chosen community, then send an oversized token_size to leak stack canaries and pointers, overwrite the return address, or crash the supernode.

events.title: CVE-2026-136406
events.summary: Canvas 7.0.0 before 7.2.11 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Contributors to inject scripts by exploiting a libxml2 parser differential in PostBody::clean(). Attackers can publish posts with slash-separated event handler attributes rendered unescaped in show.blade.php, hijacking Editor or Admin sessions to escalate their role to Admin.

events.title: CVE-2026-136407
events.summary: Marley through 16.8.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated patient-portal users to create payment records against other patients' documents by supplying arbitrary patient and docname values. Attackers can call the get_payment_link endpoint, which saves Healthcare Payment Records with ignore_permissions, to corrupt another patient's payment history and reconciliation data.

events.title: CVE-2026-136408
events.summary: Obtainium before 1.7.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows remote attackers to write or delete JSON files outside app_data by supplying an app id containing ../ sequences. Attackers can serve an obtainium://app deep link with a crafted id that, once imported, overwrites other app configurations or writes files to shared storage, and later deletes them on app removal.

events.title: CVE-2026-136409
events.summary: Obtainium before 1.7.5 trusts the allowIdChange field in imported app data, allowing attackers to bypass the package ID mismatch check by delivering crafted obtainium://app deep links. Once a victim confirms the import, attackers can silently replace a tracked app with an attacker-controlled source and install a different APK, prompt-free when Shizuku or root is authorized.

events.title: CVE-2026-136410
events.summary: Thymeleaf before 3.1.6.RELEASE contains a restricted expression mode bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to perform forbidden actions through improperly scoped expression objects. Attackers can inject input into restricted contexts like preprocessing, th:utext, th:on* handlers, fragment names, or TEXT templates to escalate server-side template injection.

events.title: CVE-2026-136411
events.summary: BusyBox through 1.38.0 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability in tftpd that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access files outside any intended directory when started without a DIR argument. Attackers can send RRQ or WRQ packets with file names beginning with '/' to read sensitive files like /etc/shadow or overwrite files, typically as root.

events.title: CVE-2026-136412
events.summary: OpenResty stream-lua-nginx-module before 0.0.20rc4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote peers to trigger access to freed memory when a receiveuntil() pattern iterator is garbage-collected while still referenced by the socket. Attackers can interrupt or close the cosocket connection so later reads or socket closure use the stale pattern pointer, crashing or corrupting the nginx worker.

events.title: CVE-2026-136413
events.summary: AppStream 0.14.5 before 1.2.3 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in asc_l10n_parse_data_qt() that allows attackers to hang compose runs by supplying unchecked tag lengths in Qt .qm files. Attackers can place a crafted .qm file with a 0xFFFFFFFB tag length, referenced by a component's qt translation element, to wrap the read offset and hang appstreamcli compose indefinitely.

events.title: CVE-2026-136414
events.summary: AppStream 0.14.5 before 1.2.3 contains a division by zero vulnerability in asc_read_translation_status() in compose/asc-utils-l10n.c that allows attackers to crash compose runs via crafted Qt .qm files. Attackers can supply a valid .qm file with no TRANSLATION records, triggering SIGFPE that terminates the entire appstreamcli compose or libappstream-compose process.

events.title: CVE-2026-135414

This issue is addressed in service software R20260720. Customers should update their domains to R20260720 or later.

events.title: CVE-2026-135799
events.summary: A vulnerability was detected in flowable flowable-engine 8.0.0. This impacts the function createElContext/importFunctions of the file modules/flowable-engine/src/main/java/org/flowable/engine/impl/scripting/JuelScriptEngine.java of the component JuelScriptEngine. The manipulation results in code injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The patch is identified as 51a9c65bae4a43dfb952f433dcfd2ad8f5eac36a. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-135800
events.summary: A flaw has been found in hiyouga LLaMA-Factory up to 0.9.5. Affected is the function save_args/load_args of the file src/llamafactory/webui/runner.py of the component WebUI. This manipulation of the argument config_path causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-136328
events.summary: A flaw was found in the file-psd plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) image file in LAB color mode, the plugin does not properly validate that a fourth channel is present when the transparency flag is set. This mismatch causes the merged-image path to allocate buffers for three components while performing color conversion with four-component formats, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

events.title: CVE-2026-136452
events.summary: browser-use before 1.0.0 contains a URL parser differential vulnerability in SecurityWatchdog that allows attackers to bypass allowed_domains, prohibited_domains, and block_ip_addresses checks by crafting a URL with a backslash before the allowed host, exploiting the mismatch between urllib.parse hostname extraction and Chromium's WHATWG-style URL parsing. Attackers can influence an LLM-controlled navigate action, such as through prompt injection, to send requests to loopback or private addresses or arbitrary external hosts before the browser redirects to about:blank, enabling SSRF and persistent state changes on the target server.

events.title: CVE-2026-136453
events.summary: browser-use before 1.0.0 contains an allowlist bypass vulnerability in the SecurityWatchdog's _is_url_match function that allows attackers to bypass domain restrictions by exploiting a raw-string startswith() comparison instead of parsed hostname validation. Attackers can craft URLs using userinfo injection or domain prefix confusion (e.g..com@attacker.com or .com.attacker.com) to redirect an LLM-controlled navigation to an arbitrary host, exfiltrating sensitive data such as secrets embedded in the URL to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

events.title: CVE-2026-136455
events.summary: borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.

events.title: CVE-2026-121725
events.summary: A maliciously crafted IFCZIP file, when imported through Autodesk Revit or Autodesk IFC for Revit Add-in, can exploit a path traversal flaw to write attacker-controlled files outside the intended extraction directory. Depending on the destination, a written file may later be loaded or executed, potentially resulting in code execution in the context of the current user. Exploitation requires user interaction to open or import the file.

events.title: CVE-2026-129969
events.summary: A maliciously crafted PDF file, when imported into Autodesk Revit, can trigger a Memory Allocation with Excessive Size Value vulnerability. A malicious actor may leverage this vulnerability to cause excessive memory consumption, potentially resulting in the application terminating unexpectedly.

events.title: CVE-2026-129970
events.summary: A maliciously crafted PNG file, when imported into Autodesk Revit, can trigger a NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability. A malicious actor may leverage this vulnerability to cause the application to terminate unexpectedly, resulting in a denial-of-service.

events.title: CVE-2026-132254
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.67 through 0.11.2, an External API key created while a user was a member of an organization keeps working in that organization after the user is removed. A former member holding such a key with the WRITE_GRAPH and WRITE_LIBRARY scopes, or USE_TOOLS for schedules, can add workflows, library entries, and schedules to the organization, where remaining members can see them. The key gives no read access to the organization's data. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.3.

events.title: CVE-2026-132264
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.63 through 0.10.0, an external API key or OAuth token that has only the EXECUTE_BLOCK permission can run AutoPilotBlock through the external API and receive a full, unattended AutoPilot turn. This lets the holder use the account owner's stored third-party credentials, library agents, and workspace files, and run AutoPilot's sandboxed shell, which the same key is refused when it requests those directly. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-133449
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.1 through 0.10.0, credentials are sent to a third party when a redirect's Location header hides the new host behind a backslash. A signed-in user who connects an MCP server URL, or runs a shared or marketplace workflow with a host-scoped credential, can have that credential delivered to a third party if the host responds with a redirect whose Location the other party influenced. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-133453
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.10.0, a user can add a version under another user's workflow ID and take over its Marketplace listing. An attacker with an account and the target's workflow ID can replace the creator's pending Marketplace submission with their own, so that approval installs the attacker's workflow under the creator's listing. Without reviewer involvement, the attacker can also stop the owner from saving new versions and break runs that name no version. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-136522
events.summary: CubeWP Forms before 1.1.13 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript by submitting unregistered field names through the public REST route cubewp-custom-form/v1/submit/, which bypasses its own nonce check and saves unsanitized values due to a missing default case in the sanitizer, later rendered unescaped on the admin Leads detail page. Attackers can send a single crafted GET request containing a script payload in a custom form field to execute arbitrary JavaScript in an administrator's wp-admin session when the lead is viewed, enabling full site takeover such as creating a new administrator account.

events.title: CVE-2026-136534
events.summary:
Devin Desktop Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Devin Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the Electron framework. The product loads a script file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of a target user. Was ZDI-CAN-33385.

events.title: CVE-2026-136535
events.summary:

The specific flaw exists within the handling of MCP stdio configurations. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-31815.

An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-29838.

events.title: CVE-2026-61512
events.summary: VeraCrypt before 1.26.30 on Linux contains a command injection vulnerability in CoreUnix::CheckFilesystem that allows a local attacker with same-UID access and an active elevated CoreService session to execute arbitrary commands by injecting an unsanitized VirtualDevice value into a shell command string. Attackers can reopen the request pipe through /proc/<pid>/fd/<n> and supply a crafted VirtualDevice value such as /dev/null; <command> to achieve arbitrary command execution as root.

events.title: CVE-2026-61513
events.summary: VeraCrypt through 1.26.31 on Linux contains an improper path restriction vulnerability in the elevated CoreService, which passes the path and owner UID from a SetFileOwnerRequest directly to chown() in CoreUnix::SetFileOwner without target validation on Linux. An attacker with an active elevated CoreService session and same-UID access who reopens the request pipe through /proc/<pid>/fd/<n> can take ownership of arbitrary system files such as /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow, achieving full root compromise.

events.title: CVE-2026-16663
events.summary:
MCUboot's encrypted serial-recovery path contains an attacker-controlled out-of-bounds stack write in decrypt_region_inplace() in boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c. The routine decrypts an uploaded encrypted image one flash sector at a time into a sector-sized stack VLA buf[sz], but when the current sector is still inside the image header it sets the destination index to the absolute header size (idx = hdr->ih_hdr_size; at boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c:156) and then decrypts into &buf[idx]. The correct sibling routine boot/bootutil/src/loader.c:876 uses the sector-relative idx = hdr->ih_hdr_size - abs_off; the serial path is missing the - abs_off term, so for any sector after the first the index runs past the end of the stack buffer.

The ih_hdr_size field is a uint16_t taken verbatim from the uploaded image header. On the second sector onward, when ih_hdr_size exceeds the sector size, &buf[idx] points beyond buf and boot_enc_decrypt() writes attacker-controlled plaintext into adjacent stack frames. The path is reached pre-authentication: bs_upload() calls boot_handle_enc_fw() (boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial.c:1208) after upload, and the pre-decryption signature gate in decrypt_image_inplace() is compiled out (#if 0 at boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c:226-233), so the header is never validated before decryption.

A second error in the same window computation affects the first sector. When a sector holds both the end of the header and the start of the TLV area, the decrypt length is clamped to tlv_off - (off + bytes_copied), measured from the start of the sector rather than from idx (boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c:166). An encrypted image whose header and payload end within the first sector is therefore decrypted for ih_hdr_size bytes more than it should be: into the TLV area and, when the image ends near the end of the sector, past buf. This form needs no oversized header, so even an ordinary small encrypted image can trigger it, and it reaches devices with sectors of up to about 128 KiB rather than only those whose sector is smaller than the 16-bit ih_hdr_size.

Reaching the sink requires a build with MCUBOOT_ENC_IMAGES and serial recovery enabled, and access to the device's serial/USB recovery interface (unauthenticated by design). With the public-key encryption schemes the AES content key is wrapped to the device's public encryption key, so an attacker can author a fully crafted encrypted image — including a malicious ih_hdr_size — without the image-signing private key. The result is a controllable stack memory-corruption inside the bootloader before any signature check, providing a path to code execution in the secure-boot root of trust that bypasses image authentication, as well as a denial-of-service. A 2048-byte out-of-bounds write was reproduced under AddressSanitizer (sz=4096, off=4096, ih_hdr_size=6144).

On releases before v2.0.0 (v1.9.0 and v1.10.0) the destination is a file-scope static uint8_t buf[SOC_FLASH_ERASE_BLK_SZ] in .bss rather than the stack VLA described above — the code then lived in boot/zephyr/single_loader.c, before commit c9fa6088 relocated it to boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c and changed the buffer's storage class. The out-of-bounds write is equally real and equally pre-authentication on those releases, but it corrupts adjacent static data rather than the stack, so a stack-smashing proof of concept written against a current release will not reproduce as-is there.

events.title: CVE-2026-16665
events.summary:
Summary

MCUboot enforces several security-critical invariants on the boot, image-swap, and validation paths using assert(). In a standard release/production build (NDEBUG defined) assert() expands to a no-op, so an invariant the code intends to halt on instead falls through, and execution continues with the bad or inconsistent state. Where the guarded condition is attacker-influenceable through the flash-write boundary (serial-recovery / DFU), this is a security check that is simply absent in release builds.

This is one root cause (assert-as-security-guard, no-op under NDEBUG) with one fix approach (replace the security-critical asserts with real fail-closed checks), so it is filed as a single advisory covering the enumerated sites.

Worst reachable instance — inconsistent swap status completes the swap without validation

In the swap-resume status read, an inconsistent status (erased_sections > 1) is detected, logged, and — when MCUBOOT_VALIDATE_PRIMARY_SLOT is disabled — is meant to abort, because "there is no way to be sure the swapped primary slot is OK." The abort is assert(0):

boot/bootutil/src/swap_move.c:181-194 — if (erased_sections > 1) { ... #if !defined(MCUBOOT_VALIDATE_PRIMARY_SLOT) / ... abort! / assert(0); #endif }, then execution falls through to compute bs->op/idx/state from the inconsistent status (lines 197-208) and return 0 (success).
boot/bootutil/src/swap_offset.c:266-280 — identical pattern; falls through to bs->op/idx/state and return 0.
boot/bootutil/src/swap_scratch.c:227-241 — same invalid/assert(0) pattern for the scratch backend.

Under NDEBUG with primary-slot validation off, the inconsistent status is neither aborted (assert is a no-op) nor re-validated (validation off), so boot_complete_partial_swap() finishes the swap on inconsistent metadata and the primary slot is booted without a signature check. An attacker who can write the swap-status trailer can craft the inconsistent status.

Reachability (threat model). Secondary slot + scratch trailers are A2-writable by definition (that is what a DFU upload is). Under MCUBOOT_SERIAL_RECOVERY the primary trailer is A2-writable too: boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial.c:978 opens flash_area_id_from_multi_image_slot(img_num, 0) (== primary) and writes from offset 0 bounded by area_size, so it can paint the primary swap-status/magic. This is how the A2 (recovery/DFU, unauthenticated by design) attacker influences the guarded condition. Property violated: P1 (image authenticity / secure-boot bypass) when un-revalidated content is booted, and P6 (boot/recovery availability).

Second reachable instance — resume-path swap_size from an unguarded trailer

boot/bootutil/src/loader.c:1190-1193: the swap resume branch does fap = boot_find_status(...); assert(fap != NULL); rc = boot_read_swap_size(fap, &bs->swap_size); assert(rc == 0);. boot_find_status() (boot/bootutil/src/bootutil_misc.c:166-204) searches {scratch, primary} and, on no-valid-magic-match, returns the last-iterated area (primary), not NULL — so assert(fap != NULL) cannot fire even in debug, and under NDEBUG neither assert fires. swap_size is then read from an A2-writable (serial-recovery primary, or scratch) trailer with no fail-closed handling. This is the same swap-metadata-trust family as the recorded resume/swap_size disclosure.

Reachable-security sites (center the fix here)

1. boot/bootutil/src/swap_move.c:193 — inconsistent-status assert(0), falls through to complete swap. A2 + !VALIDATE_PRIMARY. [worst]
2. boot/bootutil/src/swap_offset.c:278 — same, swap-offset backend.
3. boot/bootutil/src/swap_scratch.c:239 — same, swap-scratch backend.
4. boot/bootutil/src/loader.c:1191 and :1193 — resume assert(fap != NULL) / assert(rc == 0) guarding swap_size read from an A2-writable trailer; compounded by boot_find_status() never returning NULL.

(Truncated. The full description is in the advisory: https://github.com/mcu-tools/mcuboot/security/advisories/GHSA-cr9j-p626-pwcc)

events.title: CVE-2026-123626
events.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the company localisation date format. An authenticated Manager can store an arbitrary date format. When another authenticated user opens a recurring invoice, Akaunting formats dates with that value and sends the result to a raw HTML schedule description, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's Akaunting origin.

events.title: CVE-2026-133458
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From versions 0.6.15 through 0.10.0, the value of a host-scoped credential header was exposed to other hosts via HTTP redirects. SendAuthenticatedWebRequestBlock attaches a host-scoped credential's headers to a request, but once a redirect took that request to a different origin, only three fixed header names (Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie) were removed. A host-scoped credential's header names are free-form (the UI suggests X-API-Key), so a credential carried under any other name followed the redirect to the new origin. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-133460
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.11.0, public webhook endpoints woould buffer request bodies in full before verifying them. Anyone with network access to the API ccould exhaust the memory of platform API workers without an account or a valid signature. The chat-bot webhook routes were reachable only where that chat platform was configured. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-136613
events.summary:
GNU Inetutils FTP Client File Retrieval Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of GNU Inetutils FTP Client. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must interact with a malicious FTP server.

The specific flaw exists within the processing of filenames. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-29119.

events.title: CVE-2026-136614
events.summary:
GNU Inetutils talkd Stack-based Buffer Overflow Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of GNU Inetutils. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the processing of announce requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-29120.

events.title: CVE-2026-16668
events.summary:
The vendored zcbor decoder's zcbor_any_skip() in boot/zcbor/src/zcbor_decode.c descends one C-stack frame per level of CBOR nesting. On a list or map it copies the decoder state (memcpy(&state_copy, state, sizeof(zcbor_state_t))) and recurses once per member, with no depth cap: the skip path does not use zcbor's backup stack, and ZCBOR_MAX_ELEM_COUNT is SIZE_MAX, so nothing bounds how deep the recursion goes.

That function is reached on attacker-controlled bytes before any authentication. MCUboot's serial-recovery command parser decodes SMP/CBOR requests with zcbor_map_decode_bulk() (boot/boot_serial/src/zcbor_bulk.c), which skips any map key it does not recognise by calling zcbor_any_skip() on the encoded value; the echo handler in boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial.c calls it directly on the same footing. Both run during image upload, long before the uploaded image's signature is checked. The default receive buffer is MCUBOOT_SERIAL_MAX_RECEIVE_SIZE = 512 bytes and each nesting level costs a single byte to encode (0x81), so roughly 500 levels of nesting fit in one request — comfortably more than a bootloader's stack can absorb, since every frame carries a full zcbor_state_t copy plus locals.

The impact is availability only: the bootloader's stack overflows and the device faults or hangs during recovery. There is no controlled out-of-bounds write that escapes the DFU buffer, no disclosure, and no authentication bypass — the recursion grows the stack with the decoder's own internal state. Whether a given board actually exhausts its stack depends on that board's bootloader stack size, which we did not measure; the fix is nevertheless unconditional, because an unauthenticated pre-authentication code path must not have its safety depend on a per-board stack margin.

Exposure requires MCUBOOT_SERIAL (serial/SMP recovery), which is not enabled by default, and recovery entry is normally gated on a physical pin (CONFIG_BOOT_SERIAL_ENTRANCE_GPIO / PIN_RESET), with a no-valid-image fallback path. Products that expose serial recovery over an externally reachable transport, or that fall into recovery when no valid image is present, are the ones at risk.

The fix is to bound the skip: thread a recursion-depth counter through zcbor_any_skip() (or have zcbor_map_decode_bulk() reject values nested beyond a small constant) and fail once the limit is exceeded — equivalently, take the bounded-skip implementation from upstream zcbor.

events.title: CVE-2026-133459
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.63 before 0.11.0, the Office preview expands an embedded ZIP thumbnail without a size limit. A signed-in user with access to workspace file previews can exhaust the memory of a platform API worker with one small crafted DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX file and one preview request. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-133462
events.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.49 before 0.11.0, the MCPToolBlock auto-lookup allows a shared agent's author to use the MCP credentials of the user who runs it. Anyone who ran a shared agent containing an MCPToolBlock node, and had already connected the MCP server URL that the node names, had that connection used for any read, write, or delete the server exposes, with the result sent to a host chosen by the author. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-136141
